task.title: Wire the single sign-in page and explicit mode fields
task.input: M3-T2 Credentials and M1 token/client foundation; section 07 sign-in route and section 11/12 sign-in card.
task.output: /admin-login, Auth.js pages.signIn, LoginForm, and the footer entry; ordinary sign-in UI only.
task.accept: 1) Entry: public-footer Administrator sign-in (footer-admin-login) -> /admin-login. Data source: Auth.js GET/POST /api/auth/[...nextauth]. Clicking login-submit sends actual CSRF/Credentials requests and verifies the cookie plus GET account. totp sends only email/totp; password mode adds a current-password field. The interface explains that the account is not a second factor (E-09). 2) Real form requests with unchecked/absent rememberDevice or literal false create remembered=false devices; only checked true creates true. Invalid values issue no session (E-95). 3) Separately submit unknown mode, an account without enabled totp mode, nonempty recoveryCode, and nonexistent account to Credentials. Assert the same generic failure, no new device, and no account distinction. Valid password/totp requests each succeed. No ordinary recovery-code field exists; reject external or current-role-inaccessible return paths (E-96). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
